comments.text:
Completed implementation of the catppuccin-latte theme:
- Added standalone static/themes/catppuccin-latte.css based on Antharchy/Omarchy catppuccin-latte color palette.
- Added 'catppuccin-latte' to AVAILABLE_THEMES in markusmd.themes.
- Added [data-theme="catppuccin-latte"] styles to static/markus.css.
- Added BDD feature scenarios in features/themes.feature and updated features/site.feature.
- Verified with behave (all 71 scenarios passing) and ruff lint.
